purpose: Identify exactly one controllable SpaceClaim session matching the requested version and document clues.
trigger: Use when more than one application window or session could receive the next action.

inputs.name: session_inventory
inputs.description: Observed processes/windows with stable IDs, version, document identity, modal state, and busy state.

inputs.name: target_version_and_document
inputs.description: Required SpaceClaim version plus path, title, hash, or other document identity clues.

preconditions: Candidate sessions were observed from the current desktop.
Target version and at least one document identity clue are known.

outputs.name: target_session
outputs.description: Single selected session and stable window/process identity, or null when unresolved.

outputs.name: selection_status
outputs.description: One of unique, none, ambiguous, blocked, or needs_manual_review.

outputs.name: blocking_reason
outputs.description: Exact mismatch, modal, busy, or identity reason when not unique.

postconditions: Exactly one session matches and is recorded with a stable identity.
No control action is sent when the result is none, ambiguous, blocked, or needs_manual_review.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. Session identification only; it does not maximize, create a document, load a script, or execute it.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: No single session matches all identity clues.
failure_modes.detection: Filtered candidate count is zero or greater than one.
failure_modes.safe_state: No candidate is focused or controlled.

failure_modes.condition: The matching session is modal, busy, or not controllable.
failure_modes.detection: A blocking dialog or busy indicator is observed.

recovery.action: Refresh inventory and supply a stronger clue; return needs_manual_review if still non-unique.
Record the blocking state and invoke one-state recovery; do not guess a dismissal.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Exactly one session matches and is recorded with a stable identity.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
